title: Organization Evaluation
description: Output format for the Terramedic curation pipeline. Each evaluation assesses a candidate environmental organization for inclusion in the database.

country.description: Country where the organization is headquartered (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

registration_info.description: Registration number or ID if publicly available.

description.description: Brief description of the organization's mission and work.

image_url.description: URL to the organization's logo or representative image.

name.description: Source name (e.g., Charity Navigator, Charity Commission).

url.description: URL to the org's profile or listing.

rating.description: Rating or score if available (e.g., '4/4 stars', '95/100').

verification_sources.description: Third-party registry or watchdog profiles consulted during evaluation.

geographic_coverage.description: Where the organization operates, beyond just its headquarters.

scope.description: How broad the organization's geographic reach is.

operating_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the organization operates (e.g., ['US', 'KE', 'GB']).

region_code.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g., US-CA, GB-SCT) if applicable.

operating_regions.description: Specific sub-national regions where the organization operates. Use when the org does not cover an entire country.

headquarters_coordinates.description: Latitude and longitude of the organization's headquarters.

anyOf.description: Curator-proposed value not yet in the canonical list.

focus_areas.description: Specific environmental cause areas the organization focuses on. More granular than SDG alignment. New values may be proposed by the curator.

sdg_alignment.description: Which SDGs (13, 14, 15) the organization's work aligns with, and the evidence for each.

evidence.description: Brief explanation of how the org's work aligns with this SDG.

date_accessed.description: Date this URL was last accessed (YYYY-MM-DD).

excerpt.description: Short verbatim passage from the source page that supports this claim. Should be searchable on the page.

evidence_of_work.description: Concrete activities demonstrating the organization does real environmental work.

activity.description: Description of the activity or project.

date.description: Date or date range (approximate is fine).

source_url.description: URL to a source confirming this activity.

date_accessed.description: Date this URL was last accessed (YYYY-MM-DD).

excerpt.description: Short verbatim passage from the source page that supports this claim. Should be searchable on the page.

accessibility.description: How people can engage with this organization.

volunteer_url.description: URL to volunteer signup or opportunities page.

toolkit_url.description: URL to toolkits, petitions, or action guides.

categories.description: Which Terramedic pathways this org fits into.

category_copy.description: Per-category pitch for each slug in accessibility.categories. One entry per proposed category; omit for 'other'. The description speaks directly to a reader arriving on that pathway page; the action_text is the CTA label for that pathway, overriding Category.default_action_text.

slug.description: Which pathway this copy is for. Must be one of the slugs in accessibility.categories (except 'other').

description.description: One- to two-sentence pitch framed for someone arriving on the <slug> pathway page. Speaks directly to that reader's motivation — donors, volunteers, learners, etc. Roughly 120-180 characters, matching the general-description guidelines.

action_text.description: CTA label for this pathway (e.g., 'Donate', 'Volunteer', 'Browse jobs'). Overrides Category.default_action_text.

action_url.description: URL the action_text CTA links to. Use the most specific page on the org's site that supports the action (e.g. a volunteer signup page for 'Volunteer', a jobs board for 'Browse jobs', a specific toolkit page for 'Read the guide'). For slug 'donate', return the org's homepage (org_metadata.website_url) — the curation layer enforces this regardless of what is returned, because Terramedic is a 501(c)(3) and must not deep-link into other orgs' donation flows.

engagement_opportunities.description: Specific ways people can contribute to this organization. More detailed than accessibility categories.

engagement_type.description: The kind of engagement opportunity. volunteer_in_person/volunteer_remote = donating time and labor to org operations; advocacy = political or social action the org directs (petitions, contacting legislators); education = learning or awareness activities; citizen_science = data collection or monitoring; career = paid employment; donate_one_time/donate_recurring = financial contributions.

skills.description: Skills that would be useful, as snake_case identifiers (e.g., gis, legal, communications, data_analysis). New values may be proposed by the curator.

url.description: URL to the specific opportunity or signup page.

location_bound.description: Whether this opportunity requires the participant to be in the org's operating region. Defaults to true for volunteer_in_person and career, false for all others.

evidence_score.description: Overall assessment of the organization's legitimacy and impact.

score.description: 0 = no evidence, 1 = minimal, 2 = some, 3 = moderate, 4 = strong, 5 = exceptional.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this score was given.

curator_notes.description: Additional context for the human reviewer.

flags.description: Issues or uncertainties the curator wants the reviewer to check.

recommendation.description: Curator's inclusion recommendation. Always make a call — use confidence to express uncertainty.

confidence.description: How confident the curator is in its recommendation (0–100). Low values flag the evaluation for closer human review.

evaluated_by.description: The AI model used to produce this evaluation (e.g., claude-opus-4-6).

prompt_version.description: Version of the curation prompt used for this evaluation.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time, in milliseconds, for the model call (including any server-side tool turns). Omitted if not measurable.

evaluation_history.description: Prior evaluations of this organization, preserved when re-evaluating with a new prompt version.

prompt_version.description: Prompt version used for this prior evaluation.

evaluated_at.description: When this prior evaluation was performed.

evaluated_by.description: The AI model used for this prior evaluation.

score.description: Evidence score from this prior evaluation.
